subject: Map kickoff: Lumen Biotech — draft MAP & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@lumenbiotech.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@lumenbiotech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Map kickoff: Lumen Biotech — draft MAP & timeline options

Hi Sasha / Daniel —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Per our call, I’ve put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) that reflects the milestones we discussed, proposed responsibilities, and a couple of timeline options based on your priority to have inference in production for the Q4 pilot. High-level items in the draft: 

- Milestone 1 — Requirements & data access (owner: Lumen data team) — target: 2 weeks
- Milestone 2 — Integration & test environment (owner: Redwood infra) — target: 3 weeks after data access
- Milestone 3 — Performance tuning/quantization & cost review (owner: Redwood + Lumen) — 2 weeks
- Milestone 4 — Pilot validation & rollout plan (owner: Lumen PM + Redwood CS) — 2 weeks

Timeline options (pick one):
A) Aggressive: 8 weeks to pilot (target close / pilot start: 2026-08-07)
B) Balanced: 12 weeks to pilot (target close / pilot start: 2026-09-04)

Dependencies called out in the doc: access to a sample dataset (SFTP or S3 read-only), security questionnaire completion (we’ll send SOC2 artifact links), and procurement terms for a 6-month dedicated slot (if you want reserved capacity).

Please confirm: 1) preferred timeline (A or B), 2) primary Lumen stakeholders we should add to the MAP (dev, security, procurement contacts), and 3) whether we should include a reserved-capacity option as part of the pilot budget.

I’ve attached the initial MAP draft (Lumen-MAP-draft-v1.pdf) and my discovery notes (discovery-notes-lumen.docx). I’ll incorporate any edits and send a v2 for approvals.

Next steps from Redwood: we’ll provision a test instance for a short demo once we have data access and finalize the integration owner.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Lumen-MAP-draft-v1.pdf, discovery-notes-lumen.docx
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@lumenbiotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 19:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Map kickoff: Lumen Biotech — draft MAP & timeline options

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications: 

- Timeline: we’d like to target the Balanced option (12 weeks). Pilot start around 2026-09-04 works best given resource constraints.
- Stakeholders to add: Daniel Cho (PM), Priya Malhotra (Lead Data Engineer) — I’ll introduce Priya via email shortly. Please add procurement@lumenbiotech.com to the cc for contract/terms.
- Reserved capacity: we’re open to evaluating reserved capacity if costs look favorable; include it as an option in v2.

Can you also call out an acceptance criteria section in the MAP (basic latency and throughput targets plus data privacy checklist)? We’ll need that for our internal signoff.

On procurement: I’m copying procurement@lumenbiotech.com so they see the MAP and timeline. Procurement may have standard terms/PO process — I’ll ask them for expected lead time.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sasha
VP, Data Platforms
Lumen Biotech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Map kickoff: Lumen Biotech — updated MAP v1.1 (adds acceptance criteria & owners)

Hi Sasha / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Balanced (12-week) timeline. I’ve incorporated an Acceptance Criteria section and explicitly called out milestone owners and deliverables; attaching updated MAP v1.1 (attached as Lumen-MAP-draft-v1.pdf — v1.1 inside). Key updates:

- Acceptance criteria added: 
  * Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms on 4k tokens per-request profile (Redwood to validate in test env)
  * Throughput: steady-state 10 rps for pilot (Redwood + Lumen to validate)
  * Data handling: sample dataset access controls, encryption at rest + in transit confirmed
- Owners: Priya Malhotra (Lumen) — Data access & validation; Daniel Cho — PM/acceptance; Redwood (Marissa/Dev) — infra, tuning, and cost model
- Target pilot start: 2026-09-04 (Balanced timeline)
- Procurement note: we’ve added procurement lead and included an optional reserved-capacity budget line for evaluation

Dev — can you confirm the test environment slot size and if we need any additional security artifacts beyond SOC2/ISO links?

Sasha / procurement — once you confirm stakeholders and their availability for a short MAP review next week (15–30 minute sync), I’ll lock the timeline and send a formal MAP v2 for signatures.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Lumen-MAP-draft-v1.pdf (v1.1), discovery-notes-lumen.docx
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@lumenbiotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@lumenbiotech.com>, procurement <procurement@lumenbiotech.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 20:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Map kickoff: Lumen Biotech — updated MAP v1.1 (adds acceptance criteria & owners)

Thanks Marissa — looks good to me. I’ve looped in Priya (cc’d) — Priya, can you confirm access timeline for the sample dataset? If we can get read-only S3 access by 6/26 that keeps the Balanced timeline intact.

Procurement — please confirm typical review window and if a PO is required before we start the integration work.

Sasha — I’m available for a 20-minute MAP review next Tue 6/16 at 10:00am PT if that works; otherwise send a couple of slots and we’ll pick one.

Cheers,
Daniel
Product Manager, Lumen Biotech
